q_gram_b2_01_001.question: Si yo ___ más dinero, viajaría por el mundo. (tener)
q_gram_b2_01_001.explanation: After 'si' trong a hypothetical condition,  past subjunctive (-ra form) is required. Tener becomes tuviera from  irregular preterite stem tuv-.
q_gram_b2_01_001.hint: Use  past subjunctive (-ra form) của tener

q_gram_b2_01_002.question: Mis padres querían que yo ___ medicina en la universidad. (estudiar)
q_gram_b2_01_002.explanation: After 'querían que',  past subjunctive is needed vì  main verb is trong a past tense. Estudiar becomes estudiara trong  past subjunctive.
q_gram_b2_01_002.hint: main verb is past tense, nên subjunctive must also be past

q_gram_b2_01_003.question: What are the two forms of the past subjunctive in Spanish?
q_gram_b2_01_003.correct: The -ra form (hablara) and the -se form (hablase), both derived from the third person preterite stem
wrong: The -ra form from the infinitive and the -se form from the present
q_gram_b2_01_003.explanation: past subjunctive has two interchangeable forms: -ra (hablara, comieras) và -se (hablase, comieses). Both are formed from  ellos/ellas preterite stem.

q_gram_b2_01_004.question: Ella ___ en esa empresa si pudiera. (trabajar, past subjunctive, ella form)
q_gram_b2_01_004.explanation: past subjunctive của trabajar trong  ella form is trabajara. nó là formed from  preterite stem (trabajaron → trabajar-) plus  -a ending.
q_gram_b2_01_004.conjugation_info: trabajar (past subjunctive): trabajara, trabajaras, trabajara, trabajáramos, trabajarais, trabajaran

q_gram_b2_01_005.question: El médico recomendó que el paciente ___ más ejercicio. (hacer)
q_gram_b2_01_005.explanation: After 'recomendó que',  past subjunctive is needed. Hacer has an irregular preterite stem (hic-), nên past subjunctive is hiciera.
q_gram_b2_01_005.hint: Hacer has an irregular preterite stem

q_gram_b2_01_006.question: Nosotros ___ al concierto si nos invitaran. (ir, past subjunctive, nosotros form)
q_gram_b2_01_006.explanation: past subjunctive của ir trong  nosotros form is fuéramos, from  irregular preterite stem fu-. Note  accent on  first e.
q_gram_b2_01_006.conjugation_info: ir (past subjunctive): fuera, fueras, fuera, fuéramos, fuerais, fueran

q_gram_b2_01_007.question: No había nadie que ___ resolver el problema tan complicado. (poder)
q_gram_b2_01_007.explanation: After 'no había nadie que',  past subjunctive is needed vì it refers để a non-existent antecedent trong a past context. Poder becomes pudiera from  preterite stem pud-.
q_gram_b2_01_007.hint: After a negative antecedent trong  past, use past subjunctive

q_gram_b2_01_008.question: If I were rich, I would travel the world.
q_gram_b2_01_008.correct: Si yo fuera rico, viajaría por el mundo.
wrong: Si yo sería rico, viajaba por el mundo.
Si yo era rico, viajaría por el mundo.
Si yo fui rico, viajé por el mundo.
q_gram_b2_01_008.explanation: trong Type 2 conditionals, Spanish uses 'si + past subjunctive' (fuera) trong  if-clause và  conditional (viajaría) trong  main clause.

q_gram_b2_01_009.question: Vosotros ___ mejor si practicarais más. (cantar, past subjunctive, vosotros form)
q_gram_b2_01_009.explanation: vosotros form của  past subjunctive của cantar is cantarais, from  preterite stem cantar- plus -ais.
q_gram_b2_01_009.conjugation_info: cantar (past subjunctive): cantara, cantaras, cantara, cantáramos, cantarais, cantaran

q_gram_b2_01_010.question: Ojalá que mis amigos estuvieran aquí para celebrar conmigo.
q_gram_b2_01_010.correct: I wish my friends were here to celebrate with me.
wrong: I hope my friends are here to celebrate with me.
My friends wished they were here to celebrate with me.
I wished my friends had been here to celebrate with me.
q_gram_b2_01_010.explanation: 'Ojalá que' + past subjunctive (estuvieran) expresses a wish about a present situation mà is unlikely hoặc contrary để reality, translated as 'I wish... were'.

q_gram_b2_02_001.question: Si ella ___ tiempo, iría al gimnasio. (tener, past subjunctive, ella form)
q_gram_b2_02_001.explanation: trong a Type 2 conditional,  si-clause requires  past subjunctive. Tener's past subjunctive ella form is tuviera, from  irregular preterite stem tuv-.
q_gram_b2_02_001.conjugation_info: tener (past subjunctive): tuviera, tuvieras, tuviera, tuviéramos, tuvierais, tuvieran

q_gram_b2_02_002.question: Si ___ buen tiempo, iríamos a la playa. (hacer)
q_gram_b2_02_002.explanation: trong a Type 2 conditional (unreal present), 'si' được theo sau bởi  past subjunctive. Hacer becomes hiciera from  irregular preterite stem hic-.
q_gram_b2_02_002.hint: This is an unreal present condition

q_gram_b2_02_003.question: Si nosotros ___ ricos, compraríamos una casa en la playa. (ser)
q_gram_b2_02_003.explanation: trong a Type 2 conditional,  si-clause requires  past subjunctive. Ser shares its past subjunctive forms with ir: fuéramos (nosotros).
q_gram_b2_02_003.hint: Ser và ir share  same past subjunctive forms

q_gram_b2_02_004.question: What is the structure of a Type 2 conditional sentence in Spanish?
q_gram_b2_02_004.correct: Si + past subjunctive (imperfect subjunctive), conditional tense in the main clause
wrong: Si + present indicative, future tense in the main clause
Si + imperfect indicative, conditional tense in the main clause
Si + conditional tense, past subjunctive in the main clause
q_gram_b2_02_004.explanation: Type 2 conditionals express unreal hoặc unlikely present/future situations.  si-clause takes  past subjunctive (e.g., tuviera) và  result clause uses  conditional (e.g., compraría).

q_gram_b2_02_005.question: Yo ___ más contentos a mis padres si sacara buenas notas. (hacer, conditional, yo form)
q_gram_b2_02_005.explanation: trong  main clause của a Type 2 conditional,  conditional tense được sử dụng. Hacer trong  yo conditional form is haría, using  irregular stem har-.
q_gram_b2_02_005.conjugation_info: hacer (conditional): haría, harías, haría, haríamos, haríais, harían

q_gram_b2_02_006.question: Si tú ___ más cuidado, no cometerías tantos errores. (tener)
q_gram_b2_02_006.explanation: trong  si-clause của a Type 2 conditional,  past subjunctive is required.  tú form của tener trong  past subjunctive is tuvieras.
q_gram_b2_02_006.hint: si-clause needs past subjunctive, not indicative hoặc conditional

q_gram_b2_02_007.question: If they lived closer, we would see them more often.
q_gram_b2_02_007.correct: Si ellos vivieran más cerca, los veríamos más a menudo.
wrong: Si ellos vivirían más cerca, los veíamos más a menudo.
Si ellos vivían más cerca, los veríamos más a menudo.
Si ellos viven más cerca, los veremos más a menudo.
q_gram_b2_02_007.explanation: This is a Type 2 conditional. 'Si' + past subjunctive (vivieran) expresses  unreal condition, và  conditional (veríamos) expresses  hypothetical result.

q_gram_b2_02_008.question: Si yo ___ hablar chino, buscaría trabajo en Pekín. (saber)
q_gram_b2_02_008.explanation: After 'si' trong a hypothetical condition,  past subjunctive is required. Saber's past subjunctive is supiera, from  irregular preterite stem sup-.
q_gram_b2_02_008.hint: Saber has an irregular preterite stem

q_gram_b2_02_009.question: Si yo pudiera elegir cualquier profesión, sería astronauta.
q_gram_b2_02_009.correct: If I could choose any profession, I would be an astronaut.
wrong: If I can choose any profession, I will be an astronaut.
If I was able to choose any profession, I was an astronaut.
If I would choose any profession, I would be an astronaut.
q_gram_b2_02_009.explanation: This is a Type 2 conditional: 'si pudiera' (past subjunctive) = 'if I could', và 'sería' (conditional) = 'I would be'. It expresses an unreal present situation.

q_gram_b2_02_010.question: Ellos ___ en Europa si consiguieran un buen trabajo allí. (vivir, conditional, ellos form)
q_gram_b2_02_010.explanation: trong  main clause của a Type 2 conditional,  conditional tense được sử dụng. Vivir trong  ellos conditional form is vivirían (infinitive + -ían).
q_gram_b2_02_010.conjugation_info: vivir (conditional): viviría, vivirías, viviría, viviríamos, viviríais, vivirían

q_gram_b2_03_001.question: Si yo hubiera sabido la verdad, no ___ eso. (decir, conditional perfect)
q_gram_b2_03_001.explanation: trong a Type 3 conditional,  main clause uses  conditional perfect (habría + past participle). Decir's past participle is  irregular dicho.
q_gram_b2_03_001.hint: main clause của a Type 3 conditional uses conditional perfect

q_gram_b2_03_002.question: Si ellos ___ estudiado más, habrían aprobado el examen. (haber, pluperfect subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_03_002.explanation: trong a Type 3 conditional,  si-clause uses  pluperfect subjunctive (hubiera/hubiese + past participle).  ellos form is hubieran.
q_gram_b2_03_002.hint: si-clause trong Type 3 needs pluperfect subjunctive

q_gram_b2_03_003.question: What does a Type 3 conditional sentence express trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha?
q_gram_b2_03_003.correct: An unreal or impossible condition in the past and its hypothetical consequence
wrong: A probable condition in the present with a likely outcome
An unreal condition in the present with a hypothetical outcome
A real condition in the past with a factual consequence
q_gram_b2_03_003.explanation: Type 3 conditionals (si + pluperfect subjunctive, conditional perfect) express situations mà are contrary để what actually happened trong  past. They describe missed opportunities hoặc regrets.

q_gram_b2_03_004.question: Nosotros ___ antes si hubiéramos tenido el mapa. (llegar, conditional perfect, nosotros form)
q_gram_b2_03_004.explanation: conditional perfect trong  nosotros form is habríamos + past participle. Llegar's past participle is llegado (regular).
q_gram_b2_03_004.conjugation_info: llegar (conditional perfect): habría llegado, habrías llegado, habría llegado, habríamos llegado, habríais llegado, habrían llegado

q_gram_b2_03_005.question: Si tú no ___ enfadado, no habríamos discutido. (haberse, pluperfect subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_03_005.explanation: trong  si-clause,  pluperfect subjunctive is required. With reflexive verbs,  pronoun precedes  auxiliary: 'te hubieras enfadado'.
q_gram_b2_03_005.hint: Reflexive pronoun + pluperfect subjunctive của haber

q_gram_b2_03_006.question: Yo ___ de casa antes si hubiera sonado la alarma. (salir, conditional perfect, yo form)
q_gram_b2_03_006.explanation: conditional perfect (habría + past participle) được sử dụng trong  main clause của a Type 3 conditional. Salir's past participle is salido (regular).
q_gram_b2_03_006.conjugation_info: salir (conditional perfect): habría salido, habrías salido, habría salido, habríamos salido, habríais salido, habrían salido

q_gram_b2_03_007.question: Si ella ___ la oferta, ahora tendría un trabajo mejor. (aceptar, pluperfect subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_03_007.explanation: trong a mixed conditional (past condition, present result),  si-clause still uses  pluperfect subjunctive: hubiera aceptado.
q_gram_b2_03_007.hint: This is a mixed conditional with a past condition

q_gram_b2_03_008.question: If we had arrived earlier, we would have gotten better seats.
q_gram_b2_03_008.correct: Si hubiéramos llegado antes, habríamos conseguido mejores asientos.
wrong: Si llegáramos antes, conseguiríamos mejores asientos.
Si habíamos llegado antes, habríamos conseguido mejores asientos.
Si hubiéramos llegado antes, conseguimos mejores asientos.
q_gram_b2_03_008.explanation: This is a Type 3 conditional: 'si hubiéramos llegado' (pluperfect subjunctive) + 'habríamos conseguido' (conditional perfect). It describes an unreal past scenario.

q_gram_b2_03_009.question: Vosotros ___ la respuesta si hubierais leído el capítulo. (saber, conditional perfect, vosotros form)
q_gram_b2_03_009.explanation: vosotros conditional perfect is habríais + past participle. Saber's past participle is sabido (regular).
q_gram_b2_03_009.conjugation_info: saber (conditional perfect): habría sabido, habrías sabido, habría sabido, habríamos sabido, habríais sabido, habrían sabido

q_gram_b2_03_010.question: Si hubieran cerrado la ventana, no se habría mojado el suelo.
q_gram_b2_03_010.correct: If they had closed the window, the floor would not have gotten wet.
wrong: If they closed the window, the floor would not get wet.
If they would close the window, the floor would not have gotten wet.
If they had closed the window, the floor did not get wet.
q_gram_b2_03_010.explanation: This is a Type 3 conditional. 'Si hubieran cerrado' = 'if they had closed' (pluperfect subjunctive), và 'no se habría mojado' = 'would not have gotten wet' (conditional perfect).

q_gram_b2_04_001.question: Ella ___ el proyecto antes del plazo. (terminar, conditional perfect, ella form)
q_gram_b2_04_001.explanation: conditional perfect is formed with  conditional của haber (habría) + past participle. Terminar's past participle is terminado.
q_gram_b2_04_001.conjugation_info: terminar (conditional perfect): habría terminado, habrías terminado, habría terminado, habríamos terminado, habríais terminado, habrían terminado

q_gram_b2_04_002.question: En tu lugar, yo ___ la oportunidad sin dudarlo. (aprovechar, conditional perfect)
q_gram_b2_04_002.explanation: conditional perfect expresses what someone would have done. 'En tu lugar' (trong your place) sets up a hypothetical past scenario: habría aprovechado.
q_gram_b2_04_002.hint: 'En tu lugar' introduces a hypothetical situation

q_gram_b2_04_003.question: Nosotros ___ la noticia, pero nadie nos llamó. (creer, conditional perfect)
q_gram_b2_04_003.explanation: conditional perfect (habríamos creído) indicates something mà would have happened if circumstances had been different. Creer's past participle is creído.
q_gram_b2_04_003.hint: conditional perfect expresses an unrealized past action

q_gram_b2_04_004.question: When is  conditional perfect (habría + past participle) used trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha?
q_gram_b2_04_004.correct: To express what would have happened in the past under different circumstances, or to speculate about the past
wrong: To express what will have happened by a future point in time
To express what had happened before another past event
To express what someone wanted to happen in the present
q_gram_b2_04_004.explanation: conditional perfect has two main uses: (1)  main clause của Type 3 conditionals (what would have happened), và (2) speculation hoặc conjecture about past events.

q_gram_b2_04_005.question: Tú ___ la verdad antes, pero no te atreviste. (decir, conditional perfect, tú form)
q_gram_b2_04_005.explanation: conditional perfect tú form is habrías + past participle. Decir has  irregular past participle dicho.
q_gram_b2_04_005.conjugation_info: decir (conditional perfect): habría dicho, habrías dicho, habría dicho, habríamos dicho, habríais dicho, habrían dicho

q_gram_b2_04_006.question: ¿Quién ___ que ese equipo ganaría la final? (pensar, conditional perfect)
q_gram_b2_04_006.explanation: Here  conditional perfect được sử dụng cho speculation about  past: 'Who would have thought...?'  form is habría pensado.
q_gram_b2_04_006.hint: conditional perfect can express past speculation

q_gram_b2_04_007.question: I would have called you, but I lost my phone.
q_gram_b2_04_007.correct: Te habría llamado, pero perdí mi teléfono.
wrong: Te hubiera llamado, pero perdía mi teléfono.
Te llamaría, pero perdí mi teléfono.
Te había llamado, pero perdí mi teléfono.
q_gram_b2_04_007.explanation: conditional perfect (habría llamado) expresses what would have happened.  'pero' clause uses  preterite để state  factual obstacle.

q_gram_b2_04_008.question: Sin tu ayuda, yo no ___ el trabajo a tiempo. (completar, conditional perfect)
q_gram_b2_04_008.explanation: 'Sin tu ayuda' (without your help) sets up an implied counterfactual past condition.  conditional perfect (habría completado) expresses  unrealized outcome.
q_gram_b2_04_008.hint: 'Sin + noun' can introduce an implied past condition

q_gram_b2_04_009.question: A las diez de la noche, los invitados ya se habrían marchado.
q_gram_b2_04_009.correct: By ten at night, the guests would have already left.
wrong: At ten at night, the guests had already left.
By ten at night, the guests already left.
At ten at night, the guests would already leave.
q_gram_b2_04_009.explanation: conditional perfect (se habrían marchado) here expresses conjecture about what probably happened tại a past time. 'Ya' (already) emphasizes  completed nature của  action.

q_gram_b2_04_010.question: Ellos ___ el vuelo si no hubiera habido tráfico. (perder, conditional perfect, ellos form)
q_gram_b2_04_010.explanation: trong  main clause của a Type 3 conditional,  conditional perfect được sử dụng.  negative form cho ellos is 'no habrían perdido'. Perder's past participle is perdido.
q_gram_b2_04_010.conjugation_info: perder (conditional perfect): habría perdido, habrías perdido, habría perdido, habríamos perdido, habríais perdido, habrían perdido

q_gram_b2_05_001.question: Para el próximo mes, yo ya ___ este libro. (leer, future perfect)
q_gram_b2_05_001.explanation: future perfect (habré + past participle) expresses an action mà will be completed by a future point. Leer's past participle is leído.
q_gram_b2_05_001.hint: 'Para el próximo mes' indicates a future deadline

q_gram_b2_05_002.question: Cuando tú llegues, nosotros ya ___ de cenar. (terminar, future perfect)
q_gram_b2_05_002.explanation: future perfect expresses mà an action will be completed before another future event. 'Habremos terminado' = 'we will have finished'.
q_gram_b2_05_002.hint: 'Cuando llegues' sets a future reference point

q_gram_b2_05_003.question: What are the two main uses of the future perfect tense in Spanish?
q_gram_b2_05_003.correct: To express an action completed before a future point in time, and to speculate about what has probably happened
wrong: To express a habitual action in the future and a completed past action
To express a future plan and a condition for that plan
To express desire about the future and doubt about the present
q_gram_b2_05_003.explanation: future perfect (habré hablado) serves two purposes: (1) actions completed by a future deadline, và (2) conjecture about recent past events (e.g., 'habrá salido' = 'he has probably left').

q_gram_b2_05_004.question: Ella ___ toda la serie antes de que estrenen la nueva temporada. (ver, future perfect, ella form)
q_gram_b2_05_004.explanation: future perfect ella form is habrá + past participle. Ver has  irregular past participle visto.
q_gram_b2_05_004.conjugation_info: ver (future perfect): habré visto, habrás visto, habrá visto, habremos visto, habréis visto, habrán visto

q_gram_b2_05_005.question: ¿Dónde ___ mis llaves? No las encuentro por ningún lado. (poner, future perfect, yo form)
q_gram_b2_05_005.explanation: Here  future perfect expresses conjecture about a recent event: 'Where can I have put my keys?' Poner has  irregular past participle puesto.
q_gram_b2_05_005.hint: future perfect can express speculation about  recent past

q_gram_b2_05_006.question: Ellos ___ de la ciudad antes de que empiece la tormenta. (salir, future perfect, ellos form)
q_gram_b2_05_006.explanation: future perfect (habrán salido) indicates  action will be completed before  storm begins.  ellos form uses habrán + past participle.
q_gram_b2_05_006.conjugation_info: salir (future perfect): habré salido, habrás salido, habrá salido, habremos salido, habréis salido, habrán salido

q_gram_b2_05_007.question: Para finales de año, la empresa ___ más de mil empleados. (contratar, future perfect)
q_gram_b2_05_007.explanation: future perfect được sử dụng để express what will have been completed by a future point. 'Para finales de año' sets  future deadline.
q_gram_b2_05_007.hint: 'Para finales de año' signals a future deadline

q_gram_b2_05_008.question: By the time you arrive, I will have already prepared dinner.
q_gram_b2_05_008.correct: Para cuando llegues, yo ya habré preparado la cena.
wrong: Cuando llegas, yo ya preparé la cena.
Para cuando llegues, yo ya habría preparado la cena.
Cuando llegues, yo ya prepararé la cena.
q_gram_b2_05_008.explanation: future perfect (habré preparado) expresses an action mà will be completed before another future event (your arrival). 'Para cuando' + subjunctive introduces  future reference point.

q_gram_b2_05_009.question: Vosotros ___ el informe antes de la reunión. (escribir, future perfect, vosotros form)
q_gram_b2_05_009.explanation: future perfect vosotros form is habréis + past participle. Escribir has  irregular past participle escrito.
q_gram_b2_05_009.conjugation_info: escribir (future perfect): habré escrito, habrás escrito, habrá escrito, habremos escrito, habréis escrito, habrán escrito

q_gram_b2_05_010.question: ¿Habrán recibido ya mi solicitud? La envié hace una semana.
q_gram_b2_05_010.correct: Will they have received my application already? I sent it a week ago.
wrong: Had they received my application already? I sent it a week ago.
Would they have received my application already? I sent it a week ago.
Did they receive my application already? I sent it a week ago.
q_gram_b2_05_010.explanation: future perfect (habrán recibido) được sử dụng here để speculate about whether something has probably happened. It translates as 'will they have received' hoặc 'do you think they have received'.

q_gram_b2_06_001.question: Yo ___ todo si me hubieras avisado antes. (comprender, pluperfect subjunctive, yo form)
q_gram_b2_06_001.explanation: pluperfect subjunctive is formed with hubiera/hubiese + past participle.  yo form is hubiera comprendido.
q_gram_b2_06_001.conjugation_info: comprender (pluperfect subjunctive): hubiera comprendido, hubieras comprendido, hubiera comprendido, hubiéramos comprendido, hubierais comprendido, hubieran comprendido

q_gram_b2_06_002.question: Ojalá que nosotros ___ más tiempo en esa ciudad. (pasar, pluperfect subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_06_002.explanation: 'Ojalá que' + pluperfect subjunctive expresses a wish about  past mà did not come true.  nosotros form is hubiéramos pasado.
q_gram_b2_06_002.hint: 'Ojalá que' + pluperfect subjunctive = unfulfilled past wish

q_gram_b2_06_003.question: Me molestó que ellos no ___ a la reunión. (venir, pluperfect subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_06_003.explanation: After 'me molestó que' (it bothered me mà),  pluperfect subjunctive được sử dụng when referring để an action prior để  past emotion.  form is hubieran venido.
q_gram_b2_06_003.hint: emotion is past, và  action happened before  emotion

q_gram_b2_06_004.question: What is the difference between the past subjunctive and the pluperfect subjunctive?
q_gram_b2_06_004.correct: The past subjunctive refers to present/future unreal situations, while the pluperfect subjunctive refers to past unreal situations that can no longer be changed
wrong: The past subjunctive is more formal than the pluperfect subjunctive
The pluperfect subjunctive is used only in si-clauses, while the past subjunctive is used everywhere else
The past subjunctive uses -ra endings and the pluperfect subjunctive uses -se endings
q_gram_b2_06_004.explanation: past subjunctive (hablara) deals with present/future hypothetical situations, while  pluperfect subjunctive (hubiera hablado) deals with past counterfactual situations mà are impossible để change.

q_gram_b2_06_005.question: Tú ___ el error si hubieras revisado el documento. (descubrir, pluperfect subjunctive, tú form)
q_gram_b2_06_005.explanation: pluperfect subjunctive tú form is hubieras + past participle. Descubrir has  irregular past participle descubierto.
q_gram_b2_06_005.conjugation_info: descubrir (pluperfect subjunctive): hubiera descubierto, hubieras descubierto, hubiera descubierto, hubiéramos descubierto, hubierais descubierto, hubieran descubierto

q_gram_b2_06_006.question: Dudaba que ella ___ la carta antes de la ceremonia. (escribir, pluperfect subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_06_006.explanation: After 'dudaba que',  pluperfect subjunctive được sử dụng when  doubted action happened prior để  main verb. Escribir has  irregular past participle escrito.

q_gram_b2_06_007.question: I wish I had studied abroad when I was young.
q_gram_b2_06_007.correct: Ojalá hubiera estudiado en el extranjero cuando era joven.
wrong: Ojalá estudiara en el extranjero cuando era joven.
Ojalá habría estudiado en el extranjero cuando era joven.
Ojalá había estudiado en el extranjero cuando era joven.
q_gram_b2_06_007.explanation: 'Ojalá' + pluperfect subjunctive (hubiera estudiado) expresses an impossible wish about  past.  past subjunctive (estudiara) would refer để  present hoặc future instead.

q_gram_b2_06_008.question: No creía que ellos ___ la verdad hasta ese momento. (saber, pluperfect subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_06_008.explanation: After 'no creía que',  pluperfect subjunctive is needed vì  believed action occurred before  main verb (creía).  form is hubieran sabido.
q_gram_b2_06_008.hint: Doubt trong  past about an even earlier action

q_gram_b2_06_009.question: Era imposible que el tren hubiera llegado a tiempo con tanta nieve.
q_gram_b2_06_009.correct: It was impossible that the train had arrived on time with so much snow.
wrong: It is impossible that the train arrived on time with so much snow.
It was impossible that the train would arrive on time with so much snow.
It was impossible that the train will have arrived on time with so much snow.
q_gram_b2_06_009.explanation: pluperfect subjunctive (hubiera llegado) after 'era imposible que' expresses doubt about a completed past action. It translates naturally as 'had arrived' trong English.

q_gram_b2_06_010.question: Nosotros ___ antes si hubiéramos tenido más información. (actuar, conditional perfect, nosotros form)
q_gram_b2_06_010.explanation: trong  result clause của a Type 3 conditional,  conditional perfect được sử dụng.  nosotros form is habríamos + past participle: habríamos actuado.
q_gram_b2_06_010.conjugation_info: actuar (conditional perfect): habría actuado, habrías actuado, habría actuado, habríamos actuado, habríais actuado, habrían actuado

q_gram_b2_07_001.question: Aunque ___ mucho, iremos a la excursión. (llover, present subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_07_001.explanation: 'Aunque' + subjunctive expresses a concession about something uncertain hoặc hypothetical. Since  rain is uncertain,  present subjunctive (llueva) được sử dụng.

q_gram_b2_07_002.question: Aunque María ___ enferma ayer, fue a trabajar. (estar, indicative)
q_gram_b2_07_002.explanation: 'Aunque' + indicative expresses a concession about a known fact. Since María was actually sick (a fact),  imperfect indicative (estaba) được sử dụng.

q_gram_b2_07_003.question: How does  mood (indicative vs. subjunctive) change  có nghĩa là của 'aunque'?
q_gram_b2_07_003.correct: 'Aunque' + indicative means 'although' (stating a fact), while 'aunque' + subjunctive means 'even if' (uncertain or hypothetical)
wrong: 'Aunque' + indicative is for present tense and 'aunque' + subjunctive is for past tense
'Aunque' + indicative is informal and 'aunque' + subjunctive is formal
'Aunque' + indicative is for positive statements and 'aunque' + subjunctive is for negative ones
q_gram_b2_07_003.explanation: choice between indicative và subjunctive after 'aunque' depends on whether  speaker presents  information as a known fact (indicative) hoặc as uncertain/hypothetical (subjunctive).

q_gram_b2_07_004.question: Aunque ella no ___ de acuerdo, aceptó la decisión. (estar, past indicative, ella form)
q_gram_b2_07_004.explanation: Since  sentence states a past fact (she was not trong agreement),  indicative được sử dụng with 'aunque'.  imperfect estaba describes an ongoing past state.
q_gram_b2_07_004.conjugation_info: estar (imperfect indicative): estaba, estabas, estaba, estábamos, estabais, estaban

q_gram_b2_07_005.question: Aunque ___ todo el dinero del mundo, no podría comprar la felicidad. (tener, past subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_07_005.explanation: 'Aunque' + past subjunctive expresses a hypothetical concession about an unreal present situation. Having all  money trong  world is clearly hypothetical.
q_gram_b2_07_005.hint: This is clearly a hypothetical, unreal scenario

q_gram_b2_07_006.question: Nosotros ___ el proyecto aunque el jefe no lo aprobara. (continuar, conditional, nosotros form)
q_gram_b2_07_006.explanation: main clause paired with 'aunque' + past subjunctive uses  conditional để express what would happen despite  concession.
q_gram_b2_07_006.conjugation_info: continuar (conditional): continuaría, continuarías, continuaría, continuaríamos, continuaríais, continuarían

q_gram_b2_07_007.question: Aunque ___ cansados, los jugadores siguieron entrenando con intensidad. (estar, indicative)
q_gram_b2_07_007.explanation: Since  fatigue is presented as a known fact ( players were actually tired), 'aunque' được theo sau bởi  indicative.  imperfect (estaban) describes  ongoing state.

q_gram_b2_07_008.question: Even if they offered me double the salary, I would not accept that job.
q_gram_b2_07_008.correct: Aunque me ofrecieran el doble del salario, no aceptaría ese trabajo.
wrong: Aunque me ofrecen el doble del salario, no acepto ese trabajo.
Aunque me ofrecerían el doble del salario, no aceptaría ese trabajo.
Aunque me ofrezcan el doble del salario, no acepté ese trabajo.
q_gram_b2_07_008.explanation: 'Even if' expresses a hypothetical concession, requiring 'aunque' + past subjunctive (ofrecieran) cho a present unreal condition, with  conditional (aceptaría) trong  main clause.

q_gram_b2_07_009.question: Tú ___ la misma decisión aunque pudieras volver atrás en el tiempo. (tomar, conditional, tú form)
q_gram_b2_07_009.explanation: trong  main clause của a concessive sentence with 'aunque' + past subjunctive,  conditional được sử dụng.  tú conditional của tomar is tomarías.
q_gram_b2_07_009.conjugation_info: tomar (conditional): tomaría, tomarías, tomaría, tomaríamos, tomaríais, tomarían

q_gram_b2_07_010.question: Aunque no tenga experiencia, va a solicitar el puesto de trabajo.
q_gram_b2_07_010.correct: Even though she may not have experience, she is going to apply for the position.
wrong: Although she does not have experience, she applied for the position.
Even if she had no experience, she would apply for the position.
Although she did not have experience, she was going to apply for the position.
q_gram_b2_07_010.explanation: 'Aunque' + present subjunctive (tenga) indicates uncertainty about  conceded fact ('she may hoặc may not have experience'), while  indicative main clause (va a solicitar) states  definite intention.

q_gram_b2_08_001.question: La mujer ___ hijos estudian en el extranjero vive en mi calle. (relative pronoun cho possession)
q_gram_b2_08_001.explanation: 'Cuyo/a/os/as' is  possessive relative pronoun có nghĩa là 'whose'. It agrees with  noun it modifies (hijos, nam tính số nhiều), so cuyos is correct.
q_gram_b2_08_001.conjugation_info: cuyo (possessive relative): cuyo (m.sg.), cuya (f.sg.), cuyos (m.pl.), cuyas (f.pl.)

q_gram_b2_08_002.question: La empresa para ___ trabajo tiene oficinas en toda Europa. (relative pronoun after preposition)
q_gram_b2_08_002.explanation: After prepositions, 'el cual/la cual/los cuales/las cuales' được sử dụng, especially trong formal hoặc written Spanish. Since 'empresa' is nữ tính số ít, 'la cual' is correct.
q_gram_b2_08_002.hint: relative pronoun must agree with 'empresa' (nữ tính)

q_gram_b2_08_003.question: El edificio en ___ vivimos fue construido en el siglo XIX. (relative pronoun after 'en')
q_gram_b2_08_003.explanation: After prepositions like 'en',  construction 'el/la cual' hoặc 'el/la que' can be used. Since 'edificio' is nam tính số ít, 'el cual' is correct.
q_gram_b2_08_003.hint: After a preposition, use 'el/la cual' hoặc 'el/la que'

q_gram_b2_08_004.question: What is the difference between 'que', 'el cual', and 'cuyo' as relative pronouns?
q_gram_b2_08_004.correct: 'Que' is the most common relative pronoun, 'el cual' is used after prepositions or for clarity, and 'cuyo' expresses possession (whose)
wrong: 'Que' is for people, 'el cual' is for things, and 'cuyo' is for places
'Que' is informal, 'el cual' is formal, and 'cuyo' is archaic
'Que' is for subjects, 'el cual' is for objects, and 'cuyo' is for indirect objects
q_gram_b2_08_004.explanation: 'Que' is  default relative pronoun. 'El cual/la cual' is preferred after prepositions hoặc when clarifying mà antecedent is referred để. 'Cuyo' functions as a possessive adjective có nghĩa là 'whose'.

q_gram_b2_08_005.question: Las razones por ___ dimitió el director no están claras. (relative pronoun after 'por', số nhiều)
q_gram_b2_08_005.explanation: After  preposition 'por', 'las cuales' được sử dụng và agrees with 'razones' (nữ tính số nhiều). 'Por las cuales' có nghĩa là 'cho mà / vì của mà'.
q_gram_b2_08_005.conjugation_info: el cual (relative pronoun): el cual (m.sg.), la cual (f.sg.), los cuales (m.pl.), las cuales (f.pl.)

q_gram_b2_08_006.question: Tengo una amiga ___ madre es médica y ___ padre es abogado. (cuyo, two blanks)
q_gram_b2_08_006.explanation: 'Cuyo/a' agrees with  possessed noun, not  possessor. 'Madre' is nữ tính (cuya) và 'padre' is nam tính (cuyo).
q_gram_b2_08_006.hint: 'Cuyo' agrees with  noun mà follows it, not  antecedent

q_gram_b2_08_007.question: The city in which we met has changed a lot.
q_gram_b2_08_007.correct: La ciudad en la cual nos conocimos ha cambiado mucho.
wrong: La ciudad en que nos conocíamos ha cambiado mucho.
La ciudad cuya nos conocimos ha cambiado mucho.
La ciudad la cual nos conocimos ha cambiado mucho.
q_gram_b2_08_007.explanation: 'En la cual' (trong mà) is  formal relative pronoun construction after a preposition. 'La cual' agrees with 'ciudad' (nữ tính số ít).  preterite 'conocimos' được sử dụng cho  specific past event.

q_gram_b2_08_008.question: El autor ___ novela ganó el premio es de Colombia. (cuyo, agreeing with 'novela')
q_gram_b2_08_008.explanation: 'Cuya' must agree with 'novela' (nữ tính số ít), not with 'autor' (nam tính). This is a key quy tắc: cuyo agrees with  noun it modifies ( possessed thing).
q_gram_b2_08_008.hint: Remember: cuyo agrees with  following noun, not  antecedent

q_gram_b2_08_009.question: Visitamos el museo, el cual había sido renovado recientemente.
q_gram_b2_08_009.correct: We visited the museum, which had been recently renovated.
wrong: We visited the museum whose renovation was recent.
We visited the museum that had been recently renovated.
We visited the museum in which had been recently renovated.
q_gram_b2_08_009.explanation: 'El cual' được sử dụng here trong a non-restrictive relative clause (set off by a comma) để add extra information about 'el museo'. It translates as 'mà' trong English.

q_gram_b2_08_010.question: Los problemas con ___ nos enfrentamos son muy complejos. (relative pronoun after 'con', nam tính số nhiều)
q_gram_b2_08_010.explanation: After  preposition 'con', 'los cuales' được sử dụng và agrees with 'problemas' (nam tính số nhiều). 'Con los cuales' có nghĩa là 'with mà'.
q_gram_b2_08_010.conjugation_info: el cual (relative pronoun): el cual (m.sg.), la cual (f.sg.), los cuales (m.pl.), las cuales (f.pl.)

q_gram_b2_09_001.question: ___ importante es que todos participen en la decisión. (lo + adjective)
q_gram_b2_09_001.explanation: 'Lo + adjective' creates a nominalized abstract concept. 'Lo importante' có nghĩa là ' important thing / what is important'. 'Lo' is a neuter article used cho abstraction.

q_gram_b2_09_002.question: No entiendes ___ difícil que es aprender un idioma nuevo. (lo + adjective)
q_gram_b2_09_002.explanation: 'Lo + adjective + que' được sử dụng để express  degree hoặc extent của something: 'how difficult nó là'.  neuter article 'lo' nominalizes  adjective trong this construction.

q_gram_b2_09_003.question: What does  construction 'lo que' mean, và how is it used?
q_gram_b2_09_003.correct: 'Lo que' means 'what' or 'that which' and introduces a noun clause referring to an abstract idea or an entire concept
wrong: 'Lo que' means 'how much' and is used to express quantity
'Lo que' means 'the one who' and refers to a specific person
'Lo que' means 'which one' and is used in questions only
q_gram_b2_09_003.explanation: 'Lo que' nominalizes an entire clause: 'lo que quiero' = 'what I want / mà mà I want'. It can function as subject hoặc object và refers để abstract concepts rather than specific nouns.

q_gram_b2_09_004.question: Lo que necesitamos ___ más tiempo para terminar el proyecto. (ser, present indicative, 3rd person)
q_gram_b2_09_004.explanation: 'Lo que' + clause acts as a số ít subject, nên verb 'ser' is conjugated trong  third person số ít: es. 'Lo que necesitamos es...' = 'What we need is...'
q_gram_b2_09_004.conjugation_info: ser (present indicative): soy, eres, es, somos, sois, son

q_gram_b2_09_005.question: ___ que me preocupa es la falta de comunicación entre los departamentos. (nominalization)
q_gram_b2_09_005.explanation: 'Lo que' introduces a nominalized clause có nghĩa là 'what' hoặc 'mà mà'. 'Lo que me preocupa' = 'what worries me'. It functions as  subject của  sentence.
q_gram_b2_09_005.hint: Use  neuter article để introduce 'what' as a subject

q_gram_b2_09_006.question: Ella no sabe ___ bueno que es este restaurante. (lo + adjective, ella form context)
q_gram_b2_09_006.explanation: 'Lo + adjective + que' expresses degree hoặc extent: 'how good this restaurant is'.  neuter 'lo' nominalizes  adjective trong an exclamatory sense.
q_gram_b2_09_006.conjugation_info: Nominalization pattern: lo + adjective + que + clause (expresses degree/extent)

q_gram_b2_09_007.question: No imaginas ___ rápido que pasa el tiempo cuando estás ocupado. (lo + adjective)
q_gram_b2_09_007.explanation: 'Lo + adjective/adverb + que' được sử dụng để emphasize  degree của something. 'Lo rápido que pasa el tiempo' = 'how fast time goes by'.
q_gram_b2_09_007.hint: This construction emphasizes  degree hoặc extent

q_gram_b2_09_008.question: What I like most about this city is its architecture.
q_gram_b2_09_008.correct: Lo que más me gusta de esta ciudad es su arquitectura.
wrong: El que más me gusta de esta ciudad es su arquitectura.
La que más me gusta de esta ciudad es su arquitectura.
Que más me gusta de esta ciudad es su arquitectura.
q_gram_b2_09_008.explanation: 'Lo que' introduces  nominalized clause 'what I like most'. Since  concept is abstract (not referring để a specific nam tính hoặc nữ tính noun),  neuter 'lo' is required.

q_gram_b2_09_009.question: Lo malo de vivir en el centro ___ el ruido constante. (ser, present, 3rd person số ít)
q_gram_b2_09_009.explanation: 'Lo malo' ( bad thing) is a nominalized abstract concept using 'lo + adjective'. It acts as a số ít subject, requiring 'es' (third person số ít của ser).
q_gram_b2_09_009.conjugation_info: ser (present indicative): soy, eres, es, somos, sois, son

q_gram_b2_09_010.question: Lo que no me esperaba era que cancelaran el vuelo sin previo aviso.
q_gram_b2_09_010.correct: What I did not expect was that they would cancel the flight without prior notice.
wrong: The thing I was not expecting was that they canceled the flight without previous notice.
What I am not expecting is that they cancel the flight without notice.
Which I did not expect was that they would cancel the flight without prior notice.
q_gram_b2_09_010.explanation: 'Lo que' có nghĩa là 'what' (mà mà). 'No me esperaba' is trong  imperfect (ongoing past expectation). 'Cancelaran' is past subjunctive vì it follows a noun clause expressing an unexpected event.

q_gram_b2_10_001.question: Quería ir al concierto; ___, no pude conseguir entradas. (discourse connector: however)
q_gram_b2_10_001.explanation: 'Sin embargo' có nghĩa là 'however/nevertheless' và introduces a contrasting idea. It connects two clauses where  second contradicts hoặc limits  first.
q_gram_b2_10_001.conjugation_info: Common contrast connectors: sin embargo (however), no obstante (nevertheless), a pesar de eso (despite mà)

q_gram_b2_10_002.question: La empresa ha reducido costos. ___, los beneficios han aumentado este trimestre. (consequence connector)
q_gram_b2_10_002.explanation: 'Por lo tanto' có nghĩa là 'therefore' và introduces a logical consequence.  cost reduction leads để increased profits, so a consequence connector is needed.
q_gram_b2_10_002.hint: second sentence is a logical result của  first

q_gram_b2_10_003.question: El proyecto fue difícil. ___, el equipo logró terminarlo a tiempo. (contrast connector)
q_gram_b2_10_003.explanation: 'No obstante' có nghĩa là 'nevertheless/however' và introduces a contrast. Despite  difficulty,  team finished on time, so a concessive connector is appropriate.
q_gram_b2_10_003.hint: second clause contrasts with  expectation set by  first

q_gram_b2_10_004.question: What is the function of discourse connectors like 'sin embargo', 'por lo tanto', and 'en cambio'?
q_gram_b2_10_004.correct: They link ideas between sentences or paragraphs by showing contrast, consequence, addition, or other logical relationships
wrong: They replace conjunctions like 'y', 'o', and 'pero' in all cases
They are only used in formal written language and never in speech
They modify verbs to indicate the speaker's attitude toward the action
q_gram_b2_10_004.explanation: Discourse connectors (conectores del discurso) organize text by showing relationships between ideas: contrast (sin embargo), consequence (por lo tanto), replacement (en cambio), addition (además), etc.

q_gram_b2_10_005.question: No me gusta el frío. ___, me gusta la nieve en invierno. (connector: despite mà, yo context)
q_gram_b2_10_005.explanation: 'A pesar de eso' có nghĩa là 'despite mà' và introduces a concessive idea.  speaker dislikes cold but likes snow, là a partial contradiction.
q_gram_b2_10_005.conjugation_info: Concessive connectors: sin embargo, no obstante, a pesar de eso, con todo, aun así

q_gram_b2_10_006.question: Estudió mucho para el examen; ___, aprobó con la mejor nota de la clase. (consequence connector)
q_gram_b2_10_006.explanation: 'Por consiguiente' có nghĩa là 'consequently/as a result'. Studying hard logically leads để a good grade, so a consequence connector is appropriate.
q_gram_b2_10_006.hint: second clause is a result của  first

q_gram_b2_10_007.question: He does not like going out at night. On the other hand, his brother goes out every weekend.
q_gram_b2_10_007.correct: No le gusta salir por la noche. En cambio, su hermano sale todos los fines de semana.
wrong: No le gusta salir por la noche. Sin embargo, su hermano sale todos los fines de semana.
No le gusta salir por la noche. Por lo tanto, su hermano sale todos los fines de semana.
No le gusta salir por la noche. Es decir, su hermano sale todos los fines de semana.
q_gram_b2_10_007.explanation: 'En cambio' có nghĩa là 'on  other hand / by contrast' và introduces a contrasting comparison between two different subjects. It emphasizes  difference between  two brothers.

q_gram_b2_10_008.question: El restaurante estaba lleno; ___, decidimos ir a otro lugar. (consequence connector)
q_gram_b2_10_008.explanation: 'Por eso' có nghĩa là 'mà is why / cho mà reason' và introduces a consequence.  restaurant being full caused  decision để go elsewhere.
q_gram_b2_10_008.hint: decision was a consequence của  restaurant being full

q_gram_b2_10_009.question: La situación económica es difícil; no obstante, la empresa sigue creciendo.
q_gram_b2_10_009.correct: The economic situation is difficult; nevertheless, the company continues to grow.
wrong: The economic situation is difficult; therefore, the company continues to grow.
The economic situation is difficult; that is, the company continues to grow.
The economic situation is difficult; on the other hand, the company continues to grow.
q_gram_b2_10_009.explanation: 'No obstante' có nghĩa là 'nevertheless/however' và introduces a contrasting result. Despite difficult economics,  company is still growing, mà defies expectations.

q_gram_b2_10_010.question: La propuesta fue aprobada. ___, debemos empezar a implementarla cuanto antes. (consequence connector, nosotros context)
q_gram_b2_10_010.explanation: 'Por consiguiente' có nghĩa là 'consequently' và introduces a logical result.  approval của  proposal naturally leads để  need để implement it.
q_gram_b2_10_010.conjugation_info: Consequence connectors: por lo tanto, por consiguiente, por eso, en consecuencia, de ahí que

q_gram_b2_11_001.question: Los niños ___ a jugar en el parque después de comer. (ir a + infinitive, preterite)
q_gram_b2_11_001.explanation: 'Ir a + infinitive' is a verbal periphrasis mà expresses intention hoặc imminent action. trong  preterite, 'fueron a jugar' indicates they went và played.
q_gram_b2_11_001.hint: This is a completed past action, use  preterite của 'ir'

q_gram_b2_11_002.question: Después del divorcio, ella ___ a empezar su vida de nuevo. (volver a + infinitive, preterite)
q_gram_b2_11_002.explanation: 'Volver a + infinitive' có nghĩa là 'để do something again'. trong  preterite, 'volvió a empezar' = 'she started over again / she began again'.
q_gram_b2_11_002.hint: 'Volver a' + infinitive = để do something again

q_gram_b2_11_003.question: What does  verbal periphrasis 'dejar de + infinitive' express?
q_gram_b2_11_003.correct: The cessation or stopping of an action (to stop doing something)
wrong: The beginning of a new action (to start doing something)
The repetition of an action (to do something again)
The continuation of an ongoing action (to keep doing something)
q_gram_b2_11_003.explanation: 'Dejar de + infinitive' có nghĩa là 'để stop/quit doing something'. cho example, 'dejó de fumar' = 'he/she stopped smoking'. It indicates  end hoặc interruption của an activity.

q_gram_b2_11_004.question: Cuando empezó a llover, los niños ___ a correr hacia la casa. (ponerse a + infinitive, preterite, ellos form)
q_gram_b2_11_004.explanation: 'Ponerse a + infinitive' có nghĩa là 'để suddenly start doing something'. trong  preterite ellos form: se pusieron a correr = they started running (suddenly).
q_gram_b2_11_004.conjugation_info: ponerse (preterite): me puse, te pusiste, se puso, nos pusimos, os pusisteis, se pusieron

q_gram_b2_11_005.question: Mi abuelo ___ viviendo en el mismo pueblo desde hace 60 años. (llevar + gerund, present)
q_gram_b2_11_005.explanation: 'Llevar + gerund' expresses duration của an ongoing action. 'Lleva viviendo' + time = 'has been living cho'. It emphasizes  accumulated duration.
q_gram_b2_11_005.hint: 'Llevar + gerund' = để have been doing something cho [time]

q_gram_b2_11_006.question: Ella ___ de fumar el año pasado y ahora se siente mucho mejor. (dejar de + infinitive, preterite, ella form)
q_gram_b2_11_006.explanation: 'Dejar de + infinitive' có nghĩa là 'để stop doing something'. trong  preterite (dejó), it indicates a definitive, completed cessation của  habit.
q_gram_b2_11_006.conjugation_info: dejar (preterite): dejé, dejaste, dejó, dejamos, dejasteis, dejaron

q_gram_b2_11_007.question: Nosotros ___ estudiando español desde hace tres meses. (llevar + gerund, present, nosotros form)
q_gram_b2_11_007.explanation: 'Llevar + gerund' emphasizes  duration của an ongoing action. 'Llevamos estudiando' = 'we have been studying'.  present tense của llevar được sử dụng vì  action continues.
q_gram_b2_11_007.hint: 'Llevar' is  key verb cho duration with ongoing actions

q_gram_b2_11_008.question: She suddenly started crying when she heard the news.
q_gram_b2_11_008.correct: Ella se puso a llorar cuando escuchó la noticia.
wrong: Ella empezó a llorar cuando escuchaba la noticia.
Ella dejó de llorar cuando escuchó la noticia.
Ella volvió a llorar cuando escuchó la noticia.
q_gram_b2_11_008.explanation: 'Ponerse a + infinitive' có nghĩa là 'để suddenly start doing something', mà captures  abruptness của  crying.  preterite 'se puso' indicates a specific moment của sudden beginning.

q_gram_b2_11_009.question: Tú ___ a cometer los mismos errores si no cambias de actitud. (volver a + infinitive, future, tú form)
q_gram_b2_11_009.explanation: 'Volver a + infinitive' có nghĩa là 'để do something again'. trong  future tense: 'volverás a cometer' = 'you will make... again'.
q_gram_b2_11_009.conjugation_info: volver (future): volveré, volverás, volverá, volveremos, volveréis, volverán

q_gram_b2_11_010.question: Después de la operación, el paciente dejó de sentir dolor y volvió a caminar.
q_gram_b2_11_010.correct: After the operation, the patient stopped feeling pain and walked again.
wrong: After the operation, the patient started feeling pain and stopped walking.
After the operation, the patient kept feeling pain and walked again.
After the operation, the patient suddenly felt pain and walked again.
q_gram_b2_11_010.explanation: 'Dejó de sentir' = 'stopped feeling' (cessation) và 'volvió a caminar' = 'walked again' (repetition). These two verbal periphrases show contrasting meanings: stopping one thing và resuming another.

q_gram_b2_12_001.question: En esta tienda ___ libros usados. (vender, passive se, 3rd person số nhiều)
q_gram_b2_12_001.explanation: trong  passive se construction,  verb agrees with  grammatical subject. 'Libros' is số nhiều, so 'se venden' is correct.  construction có nghĩa là 'books are sold'.
q_gram_b2_12_001.conjugation_info: Passive se pattern: se + verb (agrees with subject trong number) — se vende (số ít), se venden (số nhiều)

q_gram_b2_12_002.question: En España ___ mucho aceite de oliva. (consumir, passive se)
q_gram_b2_12_002.explanation: passive se construction uses 'se + verb' where  verb agrees with  subject. 'Aceite de oliva' is số ít, so 'se consume' (số ít) is correct.

q_gram_b2_12_003.question: Aquí ___ español e inglés. (hablar, passive se)
q_gram_b2_12_003.explanation: verb trong  passive se construction agrees with  subject. 'Español e inglés' are two languages (số nhiều), so 'se hablan' is correct. This có nghĩa là 'Spanish và English are spoken here'.

q_gram_b2_12_004.question: What is the difference between passive se and impersonal se in Spanish?
q_gram_b2_12_004.correct: Passive se has an identifiable grammatical subject and the verb agrees with it, while impersonal se has no subject and the verb is always 3rd person singular
wrong: Passive se is used only in writing, while impersonal se is used only in speech
Passive se uses the subjunctive, while impersonal se uses the indicative
There is no difference; they are two names for the same construction
q_gram_b2_12_004.explanation: Passive se: 'Se venden casas' (houses are sold — 'casas' is  subject, verb is số nhiều). Impersonal se: 'Se vive bien aquí' (one lives well here — no subject, verb stays số ít).

q_gram_b2_12_005.question: En la universidad ___ materias muy variadas. (ofrecer, passive se, present, 3rd person số nhiều)
q_gram_b2_12_005.explanation: passive se verb agrees with its subject. 'Materias' is nữ tính số nhiều, so 'se ofrecen' is correct. This có nghĩa là 'very varied subjects are offered'.
q_gram_b2_12_005.conjugation_info: ofrecer (present): ofrezco, ofreces, ofrece, ofrecemos, ofrecéis, ofrecen

q_gram_b2_12_006.question: ___ necesitan voluntarios para el evento del sábado. (passive se construction)
q_gram_b2_12_006.explanation: passive se construction begins with 'se' followed by a verb mà agrees with  subject. 'Se necesitan voluntarios' = 'volunteers are needed'.
q_gram_b2_12_006.hint: passive se always starts with  pronoun 'se'

q_gram_b2_12_007.question: Apartments for rent are advertised in the newspaper.
q_gram_b2_12_007.correct: Se alquilan pisos en el periódico.
wrong: Pisos son alquilados en el periódico.
Se alquila pisos en el periódico.
q_gram_b2_12_007.explanation: passive se construction 'se alquilan pisos' is  natural way để express this trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha.  verb 'alquilan' is số nhiều vì 'pisos' (apartments) is số nhiều.

q_gram_b2_12_008.question: En este país ___ los derechos humanos. (respetar, passive se)
q_gram_b2_12_008.explanation: passive se verb agrees with  subject 'derechos humanos' (số nhiều). 'Se respetan' có nghĩa là 'human rights are respected'.
q_gram_b2_12_008.hint: 'Derechos humanos' is a số nhiều subject

q_gram_b2_12_009.question: Se buscan personas con experiencia en marketing digital.
q_gram_b2_12_009.correct: People with experience in digital marketing are sought.
wrong: Someone is looking for people with experience in digital marketing.
People look for experience in digital marketing.
They seek out people with experience in digital marketing.
q_gram_b2_12_009.explanation: 'Se buscan personas' is a passive se construction where 'personas' is  subject và  verb agrees trong số nhiều. It translates as 'people are sought' without specifying who is looking.

q_gram_b2_12_010.question: En la reunión ___ varios temas importantes. (tratar, passive se, preterite, 3rd person số nhiều)
q_gram_b2_12_010.explanation: passive se can be used trong any tense. trong  preterite with a số nhiều subject ('varios temas'),  verb is 'se trataron' (several important topics were discussed).
q_gram_b2_12_010.conjugation_info: tratar (preterite): traté, trataste, trató, tratamos, tratasteis, trataron

q_gram_b2_13_001.question: Busco a alguien que ___ hablar tres idiomas. (poder, present subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_13_001.explanation: When describing a non-specific hoặc hypothetical person after 'busco a alguien que',  subjunctive được sử dụng vì  person may hoặc may not exist. 'Pueda' is  present subjunctive.

q_gram_b2_13_002.question: Necesito un apartamento que ___ cerca del centro y que ___ balcón. (estar, tener, present subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_13_002.explanation: After 'necesito un apartamento que',  subjunctive được sử dụng vì  specific apartment is not yet identified. Both 'esté' và 'tenga' are present subjunctive forms.
q_gram_b2_13_002.hint: apartment is not yet found, so nó là hypothetical

q_gram_b2_13_003.question: When do you use  subjunctive trong adjective (relative) clauses trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha?
q_gram_b2_13_003.correct: When the antecedent is unknown, non-specific, hypothetical, or its existence is denied or questioned
wrong: Whenever the relative clause describes a person
Only when the main clause is negative
When the antecedent is a specific, known entity
q_gram_b2_13_003.explanation: subjunctive trong adjective clauses signals mà  antecedent is not yet identified, may not exist, hoặc is purely hypothetical. Compare: 'Busco un libro que tenga fotos' (hypothetical) vs. 'Tengo un libro que tiene fotos' (specific, known).

q_gram_b2_13_004.question: No hay nadie que ___ la respuesta a esa pregunta. (saber, present subjunctive, 3rd person số ít)
q_gram_b2_13_004.explanation: After 'no hay nadie que',  subjunctive is required vì  existence của such a person is denied. 'Sepa' is  present subjunctive của saber.
q_gram_b2_13_004.conjugation_info: saber (present subjunctive): sepa, sepas, sepa, sepamos, sepáis, sepan

q_gram_b2_13_005.question: ¿Conoces a alguien que ___ tocar el violín? (saber, present subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_13_005.explanation: trong a question about whether such a person exists,  subjunctive được sử dụng vì  speaker does not know if anyone fits  description. 'Sepa' is  present subjunctive.
q_gram_b2_13_005.hint: speaker is uncertain whether such a person exists

q_gram_b2_13_006.question: La empresa quiere contratar a alguien que ___ experiencia en inteligencia artificial. (tener, present subjunctive, 3rd person số ít)
q_gram_b2_13_006.explanation: subjunctive được sử dụng after 'alguien que' vì  person hasn't been identified yet.  company is looking cho someone who may hoặc may not exist.
q_gram_b2_13_006.conjugation_info: tener (present subjunctive): tenga, tengas, tenga, tengamos, tengáis, tengan

q_gram_b2_13_007.question: Quiero comprar una casa que ___ jardín y que ___ en un barrio tranquilo. (tener, estar, present subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_13_007.explanation: Both verbs take  present subjunctive vì  house is not yet identified (hypothetical antecedent). 'Tenga' và 'esté' describe desired qualities của an unknown house.

q_gram_b2_13_008.question: I am looking for a restaurant that serves authentic Mexican food.
q_gram_b2_13_008.correct: Busco un restaurante que sirva comida mexicana auténtica.
wrong: Busco un restaurante que sirve comida mexicana auténtica.
Busco un restaurante que serviría comida mexicana auténtica.
Busco un restaurante que sirviera comida mexicana auténtica.
q_gram_b2_13_008.explanation: After 'busco un restaurante que',  present subjunctive (sirva) được sử dụng vì  restaurant is not yet identified.  speaker is describing a hypothetical place.

q_gram_b2_13_009.question: No conozco a nadie que ___ resolver este problema matemático tan complejo. (poder, present subjunctive, 3rd person số ít)
q_gram_b2_13_009.explanation: After 'no conozco a nadie que',  subjunctive is mandatory vì  existence của such a person is denied. Present subjunctive 'pueda' matches  present tense main verb.
q_gram_b2_13_009.conjugation_info: poder (present subjunctive): pueda, puedas, pueda, podamos, podáis, puedan

q_gram_b2_13_010.question: Necesitamos empleados que sean responsables y que tengan iniciativa.
q_gram_b2_13_010.correct: We need employees who are responsible and who have initiative.
wrong: We need employees who would be responsible and who would have initiative.
We needed employees who were responsible and who had initiative.
We need employees that are being responsible and having initiative.
q_gram_b2_13_010.explanation: 'Sean' và 'tengan' are present subjunctive vì  employees have not yet been found (hypothetical antecedent). trong English,  indicative được sử dụng trong translation since English does not distinguish this mood trong relative clauses.

q_gram_b2_14_001.question: Él habla como si ___ nativo. (ser, past subjunctive, él form)
q_gram_b2_14_001.explanation: 'Como si' (as if) is always followed by  past subjunctive (hoặc pluperfect subjunctive) trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha. Since 'ser' shares its past subjunctive with 'ir',  form is fuera.
q_gram_b2_14_001.conjugation_info: ser (past subjunctive): fuera, fueras, fuera, fuéramos, fuerais, fueran

q_gram_b2_14_002.question: Ella gasta dinero como si ___ millonaria. (ser, past subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_14_002.explanation: 'Como si' always triggers  past subjunctive regardless của  tense của  main verb. 'Fuera' expresses an unreal comparison: she spends as if she were a millionaire (but she is not).

q_gram_b2_14_003.question: Los niños corrían como si los ___ un perro. (perseguir, past subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_14_003.explanation: 'Como si' + past subjunctive creates a hypothetical comparison. 'Persiguiera' is  past subjunctive của perseguir (with  stem change e→i).  dog chasing them is imaginary.
q_gram_b2_14_003.hint: Perseguir has a stem change trong  past subjunctive (e→i)

q_gram_b2_14_004.question: What mood và tense always follow 'como si' (as if) trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha?
q_gram_b2_14_004.correct: The past subjunctive (imperfect subjunctive) for simultaneous/present comparisons, or the pluperfect subjunctive for past comparisons
wrong: The present subjunctive for current situations and the conditional for hypothetical ones
The indicative in any tense that matches the main clause
The present indicative for facts and the past subjunctive for hypotheticals
q_gram_b2_14_004.explanation: 'Como si' always requires either  past subjunctive (hablara) cho present unreal comparisons, hoặc  pluperfect subjunctive (hubiera hablado) cho past unreal comparisons. It never takes  indicative hoặc present subjunctive.

q_gram_b2_14_005.question: Ella sonrió como si no ___ pasado nada. (haber, pluperfect subjunctive, 3rd person số ít)
q_gram_b2_14_005.explanation: 'Como si' + pluperfect subjunctive được sử dụng when  hypothetical comparison refers để  past. 'Hubiera pasado' = 'as if nothing had happened'.
q_gram_b2_14_005.conjugation_info: haber (past subjunctive): hubiera, hubieras, hubiera, hubiéramos, hubierais, hubieran

q_gram_b2_14_006.question: Él me trata como si yo ___ un niño pequeño. (ser, past subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_14_006.explanation: 'Como si yo fuera' = 'as if I were'.  past subjunctive is mandatory after 'como si' để express  unreal comparison.  speaker is not actually a small child.
q_gram_b2_14_006.hint: This is a present unreal comparison, so use past subjunctive

q_gram_b2_14_007.question: He talks about the topic as if he knew everything.
q_gram_b2_14_007.correct: Habla del tema como si lo supiera todo.
wrong: Habla del tema como si lo sabe todo.
Habla del tema como si lo sabría todo.
Habla del tema como si lo sepa todo.
q_gram_b2_14_007.explanation: 'Como si' requires  past subjunctive (supiera) để express  unreal comparison. 'Supiera' comes from  irregular preterite stem của saber (sup-).

q_gram_b2_14_008.question: Los turistas miraban el monumento como si nunca ___ algo así. (ver, pluperfect subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_14_008.explanation: 'Como si' + pluperfect subjunctive refers để a past hypothetical comparison. 'Hubieran visto' = 'as if they had never seen'. Ver has  irregular past participle visto.
q_gram_b2_14_008.hint: comparison is about a past experience, so use pluperfect subjunctive

q_gram_b2_14_009.question: Ella actuaba como si hubiera ganado la lotería, pero solo le habían dado un pequeño aumento.
q_gram_b2_14_009.correct: She acted as if she had won the lottery, but they had only given her a small raise.
wrong: She acts as if she won the lottery, but they only gave her a small raise.
She acted as if she would win the lottery, but they had only given her a small raise.
She was acting as if she wins the lottery, but they only give her a small raise.
q_gram_b2_14_009.explanation: 'Como si hubiera ganado' uses  pluperfect subjunctive after 'como si' cho a past unreal comparison.  main verb 'actuaba' (imperfect) sets  past context.

q_gram_b2_14_010.question: Nosotros ___ como si no tuviéramos preocupaciones en el mundo. (vivir, imperfect indicative, nosotros form)
q_gram_b2_14_010.explanation: main clause before 'como si' uses  indicative (here, imperfect để describe a habitual past action). Only  clause after 'como si' requires  subjunctive.
q_gram_b2_14_010.conjugation_info: vivir (imperfect indicative): vivía, vivías, vivía, vivíamos, vivíais, vivían

q_gram_b2_15_001.question: ___ que más me gusta de esta ciudad es la gastronomía. (emphatic construction with lo)
q_gram_b2_15_001.explanation: 'Lo que... es...' is an emphatic cleft construction mà highlights a specific element. 'Lo que más me gusta' = 'What I like  most', placing emphasis on  gastronomy.
q_gram_b2_15_001.hint: This is a cleft sentence mà emphasizes  topic

q_gram_b2_15_002.question: Yo ___ que he terminado todo el trabajo. (sí que, emphatic affirmation, present)
q_gram_b2_15_002.explanation: 'Sí que' được sử dụng cho emphatic affirmation, often để contradict a doubt. 'Yo sí que he terminado' emphatically asserts: 'I really HAVE finished all  work'.
q_gram_b2_15_002.hint: 'Sí que' emphasizes  truth của a statement

q_gram_b2_15_003.question: What is the purpose of emphatic constructions like 'lo que... es', 'es... que/quien', and 'sí que' in Spanish?
q_gram_b2_15_003.correct: To highlight, focus on, or give special emphasis to a particular element in the sentence
wrong: To ask questions in a more polite way
To express doubt or uncertainty about an action
To form the passive voice in formal contexts
q_gram_b2_15_003.explanation: Emphatic constructions restructure a sentence để bring focus để a specific element. 'Lo que quiero es descansar' emphasizes 'descansar'. 'Es Juan quien lo hizo' emphasizes 'Juan'. 'Sí que lo hice' emphatically confirms  action.

q_gram_b2_15_004.question: Lo que necesitamos ___ más inversión en educación. (ser, present, cho emphatic focus)
q_gram_b2_15_004.explanation: trong  emphatic cleft 'Lo que + clause + ser + focused element', 'ser' agrees with  nominalized clause 'lo que', là số ít. 'Es' links  two parts.
q_gram_b2_15_004.conjugation_info: ser (present indicative): soy, eres, es, somos, sois, son

q_gram_b2_15_005.question: ___ María quien resolvió el problema, no Pedro. (emphatic cleft with ser)
q_gram_b2_15_005.explanation: 'Fue... quien...' is an emphatic cleft construction mà highlights  agent. 'Fue María quien resolvió' = 'It was María who solved'.  preterite 'fue' matches  past event.
q_gram_b2_15_005.hint: This cleft sentence emphasizes WHO did  action

q_gram_b2_15_006.question: Ellos ___ que saben la verdad, aunque no quieren admitirlo. (sí que, emphatic, 3rd person số nhiều)
q_gram_b2_15_006.explanation: 'Sí que' is an emphatic intensifier placed before  verb để assert  truth forcefully. 'Ellos sí que saben' = 'They really DO know  truth'.
q_gram_b2_15_006.conjugation_info: Emphatic 'sí que' pattern: subject + sí que + verb (any tense)

q_gram_b2_15_007.question: ___ que me molesta es que no me hayan avisado con tiempo. (emphatic lo que construction)
q_gram_b2_15_007.explanation: 'Lo que me molesta es...' is a cleft construction mà emphasizes  cause của  speaker's annoyance. 'Lo que' introduces a nominalized clause mà functions as  subject.

q_gram_b2_15_008.question: What I really want is to travel around South America.
q_gram_b2_15_008.correct: Lo que realmente quiero es viajar por Sudamérica.
wrong: Que lo quiero realmente es viajar por Sudamérica.
El que realmente quiero es viajar por Sudamérica.
q_gram_b2_15_008.explanation: 'Lo que... es...' is  emphatic cleft construction mà places focus on 'viajar por Sudamérica'. 'Lo que realmente quiero' nominalizes  clause with 'lo que'.

q_gram_b2_15_009.question: Tú ___ que tienes talento para la música, no lo dudes. (sí que, emphatic, present context cho tú)
q_gram_b2_15_009.explanation: 'Tú sí que tienes talento' = 'You really DO have talent'. 'Sí que' emphatically affirms  statement, often để counter doubt hoặc modesty.
q_gram_b2_15_009.conjugation_info: Emphatic 'sí que' pattern: subject + sí que + verb (no conjugation change, works with any verb form)

q_gram_b2_15_010.question: Lo que me sorprendió fue que todos estuvieran de acuerdo desde el principio.
q_gram_b2_15_010.correct: What surprised me was that everyone agreed from the beginning.
wrong: That which surprised me was that everyone had agreed from the beginning.
What surprises me is that everyone agrees from the beginning.
It surprised me that everyone would agree from the beginning.
q_gram_b2_15_010.explanation: 'Lo que me sorprendió fue que...' is an emphatic cleft construction. 'Lo que' = 'what', 'fue' (preterite của ser) links  surprise để its cause. 'Estuvieran' is past subjunctive after 'que' trong a noun clause.

q_gram_b2_16_001.question: No quiero café ___ té. (sino/pero, replacing one thing with another)
q_gram_b2_16_001.explanation: 'Sino' được sử dụng after a negative clause để introduce a direct replacement hoặc correction. 'No X sino Y' = 'not X but rather Y'. Here it contrasts two nouns.
q_gram_b2_16_001.conjugation_info: sino vs pero: sino (but rather, after negation cho direct contrast), pero (but, general contrast)

q_gram_b2_16_002.question: La película no fue aburrida ___ bastante entretenida. (sino/pero)
q_gram_b2_16_002.explanation: 'Sino' follows  negative clause 'no fue aburrida' để introduce a direct correction.  movie was not boring but rather quite entertaining. 'Sino' replaces one adjective with another.
q_gram_b2_16_002.hint: After a negative, 'sino' introduces  correct alternative

q_gram_b2_16_003.question: Quiero ir al cine, ___ no tengo tiempo hoy. (sino/pero)
q_gram_b2_16_003.explanation: 'Pero' được sử dụng when  first clause is affirmative hoặc when there is no direct contradiction/replacement. 'Quiero ir' is affirmative, và 'no tengo tiempo' adds a contrasting fact.
q_gram_b2_16_003.hint: first clause is affirmative, not negative

q_gram_b2_16_004.question: What is the key difference between 'sino' and 'pero' in Spanish?
q_gram_b2_16_004.correct: 'Sino' is used after a negative statement to introduce a direct correction or replacement, while 'pero' introduces a contrast or limitation without direct replacement
wrong: 'Sino' is used with nouns and 'pero' is used with verbs
q_gram_b2_16_004.explanation: 'Sino' requires a preceding negative và introduces what IS true instead (No A sino B). 'Pero' simply adds a contrasting hoặc limiting idea và can follow affirmative hoặc negative statements.

q_gram_b2_16_005.question: No solo habla español ___ también francés e italiano. (sino/pero, cho 'not only... but also')
q_gram_b2_16_005.explanation: 'No solo... sino también...' có nghĩa là 'not only... but also...'. This is a fixed expression using 'sino'. It adds để rather than replaces  first element.
q_gram_b2_16_005.conjugation_info: Fixed expressions with sino: no solo... sino también (not only... but also), no... sino (not... but rather)

q_gram_b2_16_006.question: Ella no estudió medicina ___ se dedicó a la arquitectura. (sino que/sino, with a conjugated verb)
q_gram_b2_16_006.explanation: When what follows 'sino' is a conjugated verb (a full clause), 'sino que' is required instead của 'sino'. 'No estudió medicina sino que se dedicó a la arquitectura.'
q_gram_b2_16_006.hint: 'Sino que' được sử dụng before a conjugated verb

q_gram_b2_16_007.question: He is not lazy, but rather very hardworking.
q_gram_b2_16_007.correct: No es perezoso, sino muy trabajador.
wrong: No es perezoso, pero muy trabajador.
No es perezoso, sino que muy trabajador.
q_gram_b2_16_007.explanation: 'Sino' được sử dụng after  negative clause 'no es perezoso' để introduce  direct correction. Since it contrasts two adjectives (not a conjugated verb), 'sino' alone is correct.

q_gram_b2_16_008.question: El problema no es difícil, ___ requiere mucha paciencia. (pero/sino)
q_gram_b2_16_008.explanation: Here 'pero' is correct vì  second clause does not directly contradict hoặc replace  first. It adds additional information:  problem is not difficult, BUT it requires patience.
q_gram_b2_16_008.hint: second clause adds information, it does not replace 'difícil'

q_gram_b2_16_009.question: No fue Pedro quien lo hizo, sino que fue María la responsable.
q_gram_b2_16_009.correct: It was not Pedro who did it, but rather it was María who was responsible.
wrong: It was not Pedro who did it, but María was responsible.
It was not Pedro who did it, however María was responsible.
Pedro did not do it, so María was responsible.
q_gram_b2_16_009.explanation: 'Sino que' introduces a full clause mà directly corrects  negative statement. 'Not Pedro but rather María' is a direct replacement của  agent, và since a conjugated verb follows, 'sino que' được sử dụng.

q_gram_b2_16_010.question: No ___ llegó tarde, sino que además no trajo los documentos. (solo, completing 'no solo... sino que además')
q_gram_b2_16_010.explanation: 'No solo... sino que además...' có nghĩa là 'not only... but also...'. When a conjugated verb follows, 'sino que' được sử dụng. 'Además' (also/trong addition) reinforces  additive có nghĩa là.
q_gram_b2_16_010.conjugation_info: Extended pattern: no solo + clause, sino que además + clause (not only... but also/moreover)

q_gram_b2_17_001.question: Quiero que tú ___ a la fiesta esta noche. (venir, present subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_17_001.explanation: When  main verb is trong  present tense (quiero),  subordinate clause uses  present subjunctive (vengas) according để  sequence của tenses. Present → Present Subjunctive.
q_gram_b2_17_001.hint: Main verb present tense → subordinate present subjunctive

q_gram_b2_17_002.question: El profesor pidió que los estudiantes ___ el ensayo para el viernes. (entregar, past subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_17_002.explanation: When  main verb is trong  past tense (pidió, preterite),  subordinate clause uses  past subjunctive (entregaran). Past → Past Subjunctive.
q_gram_b2_17_002.hint: Main verb past tense → subordinate past subjunctive

q_gram_b2_17_003.question: What is  quy tắc của sequence của tenses (concordancia temporal) cho  subjunctive trong tiếng Tây Ban Nha?
q_gram_b2_17_003.correct: Present/future/present perfect main verb → present subjunctive; past main verb (preterite, imperfect, pluperfect, conditional) → past subjunctive
wrong: The subjunctive always matches the exact tense of the main verb
Present main verb → past subjunctive; past main verb → present subjunctive
There is no fixed rule; any subjunctive tense can follow any main verb tense
q_gram_b2_17_003.explanation: sequence của tenses governs mà subjunctive tense follows  main verb. Present-sphere verbs trigger present subjunctive; past-sphere verbs trigger past subjunctive (imperfect subjunctive).

q_gram_b2_17_004.question: Dudaba que ella ___ la verdad. (decir, past subjunctive, ella form)
q_gram_b2_17_004.explanation: Since 'dudaba' is trong  imperfect (past sphere),  subordinate clause requires  past subjunctive. Decir's past subjunctive is dijera (from  irregular preterite stem dij-).
q_gram_b2_17_004.conjugation_info: decir (past subjunctive): dijera, dijeras, dijera, dijéramos, dijerais, dijeran

q_gram_b2_17_005.question: Es importante que todos ___ a tiempo a la reunión de mañana. (llegar, present subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_17_005.explanation: 'Es importante' is present tense (present sphere), nên subjunctive trong  subordinate clause must also be present: lleguen. Present → Present Subjunctive.
q_gram_b2_17_005.hint: 'Es importante' is present tense, triggering present subjunctive

q_gram_b2_17_006.question: Me alegraría que tú ___ a visitarme este verano. (venir, past subjunctive, tú form)
q_gram_b2_17_006.explanation: conditional 'me alegraría' belongs để  past sphere, so it triggers  past subjunctive. Venir's past subjunctive tú form is vinieras (from  preterite stem vinier-).
q_gram_b2_17_006.conjugation_info: venir (past subjunctive): viniera, vinieras, viniera, viniéramos, vinierais, vinieran

q_gram_b2_17_007.question: No creo que ellos ___ la tarea todavía. (terminar, present subjunctive)
q_gram_b2_17_007.explanation: 'No creo' (present sphere) triggers present subjunctive. Since  action may be completed ('todavía' = yet),  present perfect subjunctive (hayan terminado) is appropriate để express a completed action within  present sphere.
q_gram_b2_17_007.hint: Present tense main verb + completed action = present perfect subjunctive

q_gram_b2_17_008.question: The teacher wanted the students to study more for the exam.
q_gram_b2_17_008.correct: El profesor quería que los estudiantes estudiaran más para el examen.
wrong: El profesor quería que los estudiantes estudien más para el examen.
El profesor quería que los estudiantes estudiarían más para el examen.
El profesor quería que los estudiantes estudiaban más para el examen.
q_gram_b2_17_008.explanation: 'Quería' (imperfect, past sphere) triggers  past subjunctive 'estudiaran'.  sequence của tenses requires past → past subjunctive.

q_gram_b2_17_009.question: Sería necesario que nosotros ___ antes de tomar una decisión. (hablar, past subjunctive, nosotros form)
q_gram_b2_17_009.explanation: conditional 'sería' belongs để  past sphere, triggering  past subjunctive.  nosotros form is habláramos (note  accent on  a).
q_gram_b2_17_009.conjugation_info: hablar (past subjunctive): hablara, hablaras, hablara, habláramos, hablarais, hablaran

q_gram_b2_17_010.question: Le pedí que me llamara cuando llegara al aeropuerto.
q_gram_b2_17_010.correct: I asked him/her to call me when he/she arrived at the airport.
wrong: I ask him/her to call me when he/she arrives at the airport.
I asked him/her to call me when he/she would arrive at the airport.
I had asked him/her to call me when he/she has arrived at the airport.
q_gram_b2_17_010.explanation: Both 'llamara' và 'llegara' are past subjunctive, following  past-sphere main verb 'pedí' (preterite).  sequence của tenses dictates mà both subordinate verbs use  past subjunctive.

q_gram_b2_18_001.question: La casa ___ que vivimos tiene más de cien años. (preposition + relative, en + el/la que)
q_gram_b2_18_001.explanation: After prepositions, 'el/la/los/las que' hoặc 'el/la cual' được sử dụng. 'La casa en la que vivimos' = ' house trong mà we live'. 'La que' agrees with 'casa' (nữ tính số ít).
q_gram_b2_18_001.conjugation_info: Preposition + article + que: en el que (m.sg.), en la que (f.sg.), en los que (m.pl.), en las que (f.pl.)

q_gram_b2_18_002.question: La razón ___ que se mudaron fue el clima. (preposition + relative pronoun)
q_gram_b2_18_002.explanation: 'La razón por la que' có nghĩa là ' reason cho mà /  reason why'.  preposition 'por' indicates cause, và 'la que' agrees with 'razón' (nữ tính số ít).
q_gram_b2_18_002.hint: 'La razón por la que' =  reason why

q_gram_b2_18_003.question: El amigo ___ quien fui al cine es de Argentina. (preposition + relative pronoun cho people)
q_gram_b2_18_003.explanation: 'Con quien' có nghĩa là 'with whom' và được sử dụng cho people after  preposition 'con'. 'El amigo con quien fui' = ' friend with whom I went'.

q_gram_b2_18_004.question: When do you use 'preposition + el/la que' versus 'preposition + quien' in relative clauses?
q_gram_b2_18_004.correct: 'Preposition + quien/quienes' is used only for people, while 'preposition + el/la/los/las que' can be used for both people and things
wrong: 'Quien' is formal and 'el que' is informal
'Quien' is for subjects and 'el que' is for objects
'Quien' is singular only and 'el que' is plural only
q_gram_b2_18_004.explanation: 'Quien/quienes' can only refer để people: 'la persona con quien hablé'. 'El/la que' is more versatile và works cho both people và things: 'el tema del que hablamos', 'la persona de la que hablé'.

q_gram_b2_18_005.question: Los estudiantes ___ quienes el profesor dirigió sus palabras estaban muy atentos. (preposition + relative, 'a' + quienes)
q_gram_b2_18_005.explanation: 'A quienes' có nghĩa là 'để whom' và indicates  indirect object. 'Los estudiantes a quienes el profesor dirigió sus palabras' = ' students để whom  professor directed his words'.
q_gram_b2_18_005.conjugation_info: Common preposition + quien(es) patterns: con quien(es) (with whom), a quien(es) (để whom), de quien(es) (của/about whom), para quien(es) (cho whom)

q_gram_b2_18_006.question: El hotel ___ el que nos alojamos tenía unas vistas increíbles. (preposition 'trong' + relative)
q_gram_b2_18_006.explanation: 'En el que' có nghĩa là 'trong mà'. 'El hotel en el que nos alojamos' = ' hotel trong mà we stayed'.  preposition 'en' indicates location.

q_gram_b2_18_007.question: The book about which we spoke is very interesting.
q_gram_b2_18_007.correct: El libro del que hablamos es muy interesante.
wrong: El libro que del hablamos es muy interesante.
El libro sobre quien hablamos es muy interesante.
El libro de que hablamos es muy interesante.
q_gram_b2_18_007.explanation: 'Hablar de algo' (để talk about something) requires  preposition 'de'. Combined with  relative pronoun: 'del que' (de + el que). 'El libro del que hablamos' = ' book about mà we spoke'.

q_gram_b2_18_008.question: La empresa ___ la que trabajo ofrece buenos beneficios. (preposition + relative, 'cho' trong  sense của employment)
q_gram_b2_18_008.explanation: 'Trabajar para' có nghĩa là 'để work cho' (a company). 'La empresa para la que trabajo' = ' company cho mà I work'. 'Para' indicates purpose hoặc beneficiary.

q_gram_b2_18_009.question: El problema por el que estamos aquí es la falta de financiación.
q_gram_b2_18_009.correct: The problem for which we are here is the lack of funding.
wrong: The problem that we are here is the lack of funding.
The problem because we are here is the lack of funding.
The problem with which we are here is the lack of funding.
q_gram_b2_18_009.explanation: 'Por el que' có nghĩa là 'cho mà / vì của mà'. 'El problema por el que estamos aquí' uses  preposition 'por' để indicate  cause hoặc reason.

q_gram_b2_18_010.question: Las personas ___ las que confío son muy pocas. (preposition 'trong' cho trust + relative, số nhiều nữ tính)
q_gram_b2_18_010.explanation: 'Confiar en' có nghĩa là 'để trust trong'. 'Las personas en las que confío' = ' people trong whom I trust'.  preposition 'en' is required by  verb 'confiar'.
q_gram_b2_18_010.conjugation_info: Verbs with fixed prepositions + relative: confiar en (en el/la que), depender de (del/de la que), pensar en (en el/la que), hablar de (del/de la que)
